params.name: appFilterExtensions
params.description: A comma-separated list of file extensions to limit returned results. All results within the given app query scope which can open any of the given file extensions are included in the response. If `appFilterMimeTypes` are provided as well, the result is a union of the two resulting app lists.

params.name: appFilterMimeTypes
params.description: A comma-separated list of file extensions to limit returned results. All results within the given app query scope which can open any of the given MIME types will be included in the response. If `appFilterExtensions` are provided as well, the result is a union of the two resulting app lists.
